title: Delegates, Lambdas and Events
summary: Treating methods as values - delegate types, Func and Action, lambdas and method groups, closures that capture variables, higher-order methods, multicast delegates, and events for notifications with the EventHandler pattern, subscribing and unsubscribing safely.

cards.q: What is the type of a lambda that takes a string and returns a bool?
cards.a:
Func<string, bool>

In `Func` the last type argument is the return type; `Action` returns nothing. `Predicate<string>` also fits.

cards.q: Why invoke an event with TooHot?.Invoke(...)?
cards.a:
With no subscribers the event is null, and ?. skips the call

An event nobody has subscribed to is null. Calling it directly would throw a NullReferenceException; `?.` simply does nothing.

cards.q: What does this print? `int x = 1; Func<int> f = () => x * 10; x = 5; Console.WriteLine(f());`
cards.a:
50

The lambda captures the variable x, and reads it when called.
